answer: Yes, this is a real bug. The root cause is in sim/simulator.go:executeBatchStep() at line 647, where TotalOutputTokens++ is incremented on every decode step. When a request is preempted (batch_formation.go:232 resets ProgressIndex to 0), the request re-enters prefill and decode from scratch, causing each re-generated output token to be counted again. The fix moves TotalOutputTokens accumulation to recordRequestCompletion(), computing from ProgressIndex - len(InputTokens) at completion time, which is correct regardless of preemption history. Before fix: small KV (600 blocks) reports 114,630 output tokens vs large KV (5000 blocks) 106,083 — a phantom delta of 8,547 tokens. After fix: both report 105,082.
repro: ./blis run --model qwen/qwen3-14b --rate 20 --num-requests 200 --seed 42 --total-kv-blocks 600 2>/dev/null | grep total_output_tokens && ./blis run --model qwen/qwen3-14b --rate 20 --num-requests 200 --seed 42 --total-kv-blocks 5000 2>/dev/null | grep total_output_tokens
